name: Serena's Head
summary: At the Dry Hills, Darsok Swiftdagger seeks Serena Bloodfeather's head as proof of her death. He plans to display it on a Horde supply wagon to warn against further harpy raids.

sections.title: A Warning on the Road
sections.body:
Serena Bloodfeather led the Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills in attacks on trade through the northern Barrens. Her assaults on Horde supply lines grew vicious after the beastmaster Rexxar slew her sister.

Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc rogue, ordered Serena hunted to break the flock's morale. He plans to mount her severed head on an outbound caravan, where harpies watching from the crags will see the warning.

faq.q: Why does Darsok Swiftdagger want Serena's head?
aliases: what does darsok do with the head
faq.answer: Darsok wants proof that Serena Bloodfeather is dead. He plans to mount her head on a Horde supply caravan and hopes the display will frighten the surviving Witchwing harpies away from travelers.

faq.q: Why was Serena Bloodfeather attacking Horde caravans?
faq.answer: Serena Bloodfeather attacked Horde caravans to avenge her sister, whom the half-ogre champion Rexxar had slain. She struck Horde supply lines and wayfarers across the Barrens.

faq.q: Where does this trophy come from?
faq.answer: The trophy comes from Serena Bloodfeather, the matriarch who roosts among the Dry Hills crags in the far northwestern Barrens.

angles.text: Horde caravans connect Durotar to Mulgore and distant outposts. Displaying Serena's head on a supply wagon declares Horde dominance over the wild wastes.
Darsok Swiftdagger values clean, ruthless work. He praises mercenaries who slip behind enemy perches and execute a target without flinching.
